name: FSN E-Commerce Ventures Ltd
about: FSN E-commerce Ventures Ltd. (FSNEV) popularly known as "Nykaa" is a digitally native consumer technology platform, delivering a content-led, lifestyle retail experience to consumers. The company has a diverse portfolio of beauty, personal care, and fashion products, including owned brand products manufactured by it.

flags.text: Operating margin expanded 3.0 pts in 3 years (5% → 8%).
Profit compounding faster than sales (PAT 113.4% vs revenue 24.9% 3y CAGR) — operating leverage.
Operating cash ≥ reported profit over 5 years (1.63x) — earnings are real.
Negative cumulative free cash flow over 5 years (₹-74 Cr) — growth is being funded externally.

ar.what_they_do: FSN E-Commerce Ventures Ltd is an Indian beauty and lifestyle destination operating online platforms, physical retail stores, owned consumer brands, and B2B distribution networks across beauty, fashion, and personal care segments.

segments.name: Beauty
segments.note: Includes online beauty platform, owned brands, retail stores, and B2B distribution.

segments.name: Fashion
segments.note: Includes fashion platforms and brand verticals.

Strategic partnerships with global iconic beauty brands and premiumisation trends.
Rising digital commerce adoption and growing base of financially independent consumers.

ar.label: Annual Report 2026

verdict.tldr: Operating leverage drives PAT compounding (113.4% 3-year CAGR) and OPM expansion to 9% by Q2 FY27. However, negative 5-year FCF (-₹74 Cr) and rising debt (₹1,519 Cr) require close monitoring.

promises.promise: Achieve EBITDA breakeven in Fashion vertical.
promises.actual: Fashion achieved +30 bps EBITDA in Q4 FY26 and ₹1 Cr (0.2% margin) in Q2 FY27.
promises.why: Turned positive EBITDA in Q4 FY26 and sustained breakeven in Q2 FY27.

promises.promise: Expand store network to 500 stores in 3-4 years.
promises.actual: Total store count reached 324 after adding 11 stores in Q1 FY27.
promises.why: Adding 50-70 stores annually to reach long-term targets.

promises.promise: Expand Nykaa Now offering to over 25 cities.
promises.actual: Q2 FY27 net revenue reached ₹3,006 Cr with quick commerce expansion ongoing.
promises.why: Execution remains on schedule for completion by fiscal end.

promises.promise: Deliver 3 to 3.5x revenue growth in Fashion vertical over 4-5 years.
promises.actual: Consolidated revenue grew 29.1% YoY in Q1 FY27 and 28.1% YoY in Q2 FY27.
promises.why: Multi-year target; early quarterly execution shows strong top-line momentum.

promises.promise: Achieve high single-digit Fashion EBITDA margin by FY30.
promises.actual: Fashion EBITDA reached ₹1 Cr (0.2% margin) in Q2 FY27.
promises.why: Initial breakeven milestone achieved; long-term margin target reaffirmed.

promises.promise: Sustainably improve EBITDA margin in Beauty vertical.
promises.actual: Consolidated OPM expanded from 6.0% in Q3 FY25 to 8.0% in Q3 FY26 and 9.0% in Q2 FY27.
promises.why: Consolidated OPM consistently expanded from 4.3% in FY22 to 9.0% by Q2 FY27.

credibility.line: Management delivers on OPM expansion and store guidance, but remains evasive on strategic partnership terms and ad revenue ceilings.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Operating leverage is driving faster profit compounding than revenue.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: 3-year PAT CAGR of 113.4% far outpaces 3-year Revenue CAGR of 24.9%.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Business cash generation is strong relative to reported earnings.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: 5-year CFO/PAT is 1.63x, but 5-year cumulative FCF is negative at -₹74 Cr.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Beauty vertical margin expansion is structural and sustainable.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: Annual OPM rose steadily from 4.3% in FY22 to 8.0% in FY26 and 9.0% in Q2 FY27.

bull.point: Strong profit compounding driven by operating leverage.
bull.evidence: 3-year PAT CAGR of 113.4% vs 24.9% Revenue CAGR.

bull.point: Consistent margin expansion across fiscal years and quarters.
bull.evidence: OPM increased from 5.0% in FY24 to 9.0% in Q2 FY27.
Cash conversion cycle tightened from 106 days to 71 days.

bear.point: Negative cumulative free cash flow over 5 years.
bear.evidence: 5-year cumulative FCF sum stands at -₹74 Cr.

bear.point: Increasing debt balance to fund external growth.
bear.evidence: Borrowings increased to ₹1,519 Cr from ₹969 Cr 3 years ago.

bear.point: Management evasiveness on strategic deal terms and ad revenue ceilings.
bear.evidence: Evasive answers on Nike deal economics and ad contribution limits.

watch_next: FCF recovery following festive inventory normalization post Q2.
Progress on Nykaa Now expanding to 25 cities by end of FY27.
Fashion segment EBITDA margin expansion trajectory above breakeven.
